subject: Stale snapshot sweep timing & customer notification flow
messages:
From: Alice Smith <alice.smith@greenbank.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Missing snapshot after scheduled sweep

Hi Jordan,

We noticed that a daily snapshot (shard: eu-west-1 / snapshot id: gb-20260930-22) that was supposed to be retained for 60 days was removed during last night's sweep. Our retention policy should have kept it until 2026-11-29. Can you confirm:

- Whether your nightly "stale snapshot sweep" ran an expedited purge last night for any reason
- What canonical evidence (manifests/audit log entries) you can provide showing the deletion time and originating host/region

I've attached a screenshot showing the snapshot list and a small manifest we pulled. This is urgent for a compliance review.

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Smith
Head of IT Operations, Greenbank Financial
alice.smith@greenbank.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Smith <alice.smith@greenbank.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Missing snapshot after scheduled sweep

Hi Alice — thanks for flagging and very sorry for the stress. I looped in Sean from Ops and Kimberly from Security so we can get you the right evidence and timeline. Quick answers up front:

- We did run the standard "stale snapshot sweep" last night; there was no intentional policy change.
- We'll collect the manifest entries, tombstone records, and the audit log lines showing the expunge request and reply.

Sean/Kim — can one of you confirm whether any emergency remedial sweep or manual retention override happened around 02:00–04:00 UTC last night for the Greenbank tenant (account id GB-998)? Alice attached a manifest and a screenshot.

Jordan
Jordan Blake | Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 415-555-0132

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Alice Smith <alice.smith@greenbank.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 13:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Missing snapshot after scheduled sweep

On Thu, Nov 12, 2026 at 9:12 AM Alice Smith <alice.smith@greenbank.com> wrote:
> We noticed that a daily snapshot ... was removed during last night's sweep.

Hi Alice — digging in now. Summary of what we see in the internal audit pipeline:

1) The sweep job ran on 2026-11-12T02:03:11Z against shard eu-west-1. It loaded the retention manifest and evaluated 47 snapshot candidates.
2) Snapshot gb-20260930-22 matched an expunge rule due to a metadata mismatch: the tenant-level override flag (retain_until) was nullified earlier this year during a migration event (ticket JIRA-3120). As a result, the system applied the default 30-day expiry instead of your custom 60-day retention.
3) The delete operation shows a tombstone creation event at 2026-11-12T02:03:41Z and a background expunge task completed at 2026-11-12T02:07:22Z. The expunge records include {host: beta-sweep-03, job_id: sweep-20261112-02}.

Attached: a short extract of the audit log lines and the sweep manifest excerpt.

Action items we propose:
- Immediate: provide you the raw audit lines and the manifest excerpt (attached).
- Short term: confirm whether we can rehydrate the snapshot from cross-region replicas (we have copies for GB-998 in us-east-2 and us-west-1 until 2026-12-01).
- Medium: fix the tenant migration path so retain_until isn't nulled on import.

Alice — can you confirm whether you want us to attempt a targeted restore from us-east-2 now? If yes, we will prioritize and share ETA and restore logs.

Sean Gallagher
Principal Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
[attachment: sweep_manifest_excerpt.txt (txt)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Smith <alice.smith@greenbank.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 08:20:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Missing snapshot after scheduled sweep

Thanks for the quick triage, Sean. A couple compliance notes to document while we work the restore:

- Evidence package: we'll provide a signed audit bundle (timestamped lines, UUIDs, and our KMS key id) and a manifest of all deletion-related RPCs. That bundle qualifies for your internal auditors (we've used the same format for SOC evidence requests).
- Notification flow: per our SLA, customers receive a 48-hour pre-sweep retention-warning email when tenant-level retention < standard thresholds or when manifest mismatches are detected. In this case the override flag was nulled during the migration so the warning would not have been generated — we need to add an import-time validation to emit warnings for tenants that lost overrides.
- Forensics and chain-of-custody: we'll preserve the host disk hashes and job logs for 90 days and include a checksum-signed tarball in the evidence bundle.

I'll draft the evidence checklist and timeline and share a DocuSign-ready statement if Greenbank requires an attestation for the audit.

Kimberly Park
Director, Product Security (Redwood Inference)
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

From: Alice Smith <alice.smith@greenbank.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:00:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Missing snapshot after scheduled sweep

Thanks everyone — the explanation makes sense and we appreciate the proposed actions. Please proceed with:

1) Attempt the targeted restore from us-east-2 ASAP and share ETA/logs.
2) Send the signed audit bundle and sweep manifest excerpt to compliance@greenbank.com (we need the copy with checksums).
3) Confirm when the tenant-import validation is scheduled; we need that mitigated before our next quarterly audit on 2027-02-10.

I'll stand by for the restore ETA.

Best,
Alice
Alice Smith
Head of IT Operations, Greenbank Financial
